title: KPI tiles show exact figures with no change indicator
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as a user whose role has the Reports permission (for example Admin).
  2. You use a desktop browser window at least 1024 pixels wide (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  3. You can switch to a busy location (workplace) that has invoices and technician clocked time over the last twelve months.
  4. A location with nothing in it exists (for example ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop): no work order, invoice, credit or clocked time.
  5. A location with one very large invoice exists (for example ZZAUTOTEST Big Shop): one invoice, not paid, for customer ZZAUTOTEST Big Fleet, with one part of Sell Price $1,234,567.89 and no labor.

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 3: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site try Staging Heavy Duty - 9919. Check: on the Dashboard, switch the Revenue and Technician Efficiency pills to Last 12 Months: both show figures; then set both back to This Month (the dashboard remembers your choices in this browser). If not, try the other locations in the list. If no location in the list passes this check, mark the case Blocked and write in the result comment that no location has this data.
  • For 4: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. Create nothing in it.
  • For 5: profile icon > Settings > Locations > New Location: Name ZZAUTOTEST Big Shop, the address fields, Timezone, Telephone, Shop Supplies Charge 0 % > Save & Close (if a location with this name already exists, reuse it only if it still matches the precondition). It then appears in your Change Location list; to switch to it, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list; switch to it; Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (ZZAUTOTEST Big Fleet); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); in New Line: What Are You Doing? (any text), no labor, tick Line Approved > Save & Add Part, and add a part with Sell Price $1,234,567.89 (it must show In stock, or be ordered and received); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice).
custom_steps:
1. With your busy location selected, click Dashboard in the top menu and look at the four top tiles for any up or down arrow, plus/minus percentage or "vs last period" figure.
  2. Change location to ZZAUTOTEST Empty Shop (profile icon > Change Location) and read the Revenue supporting line.
  3. Change location to ZZAUTOTEST Big Shop (profile icon > Change Location) and read the Revenue headline.
  4. Click the arrow icon beside "Revenue" and read the Sales report total.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No KPI tile shows an up/down arrow, change percentage or any other change figure. The small trend line is the only comparison.
  • With no parts and labor split to show (no revenue), the Revenue supporting line reads the invoice count instead (e.g. "0 Invoices").
  • The very large value is shown in full to the cent, "$1,234,567.89", the same as the Sales report total. It is not shortened (no "$1.2M") and not rounded.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9576 (Story 4, KPI Hero Tiles); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 4. Design canvas board 15_Empty_Design (row 15) shows the "0 Invoices" line.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N1: “No KPI tile shows a delta indicator; the sparkline is the only comparison.”
  • S4-N2: “If the Revenue tile has no parts-versus-labor split to show, its supporting line reads "{count} Invoices" instead.”
  • S4-E1: “If the underlying report has an extreme value, the tile headline still shows the true figure to the report's precision.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
